title: The Customizer
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: The Nyborg Customizer is here: one page to make Nyborgs, give each a look (yarn hair, 2 to 4 strands, glasses, a hat) and set its build for every game. Your library lives in this browser, and you can export or import any Nyborg as a small JSON file.

Each game tab is built straight from the engine's own catalog, so every Nyborg gets the same point budget, and the same validator the engine uses checks every change before it's saved. Pick two Nyborgs and Watch opens their tank match in the viewer.
next: A nav link after the Coastal re-theme, then racing with your own Nyborgs and their looks in the viewer.
